This role is designed for a sharp, strategic operator who can navigate the complex intersection of AI, data engineering and global regulation. You will be responsible for helping Fortune 500 leaders build an AI-ready data foundation. You must thrive in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment and work async with limited managerial oversight to turn compliance into a competitive advantage for our customers. This is a remote, Exempt , Full-Time position based in the United States. The successful candidate must have valid work authorization, as visa sponsorship is not available. Work hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. EST (Eastern Standard Time). This role reports directly to the Director of Customer Success. Strategic Storytelling: Ability to articulate Transcend’s value not just as “complaince”, but as the engine that enables responsible AI and personalized customer experiences. Technical Intelligence: Ability to master a deep technical stack to strategically advise stakeholders through their data journey. Async & Remote Efficacy: Expert-level ability to communicate clearly via writing, recorded demos, and documentation to drive results across distributed teams. Agility & Grit: Comfort with the ambiguity of a startup; you are resilient, proactive, and capable of high-velocity execution. Preferred: AI/Data Engineering Context: Familiarity with how enterprises build AI pipelines or manage large-scale data warehouses (Snowflakes, Databricks, etc.) This role is eligible for: Variable Sales Incentive Compensation : Transcend’s Incentive Plan is designed to reward achievement of Org goals. 360cap-id5-io:greenhouse:6005578004.title: Senior Product Manager
360cap-id5-io:greenhouse:6005578004.description: ID5 enables addressable and measurable advertising to support the growth of the digital economy and provide free and safe access to content and services. Technical changes, signal loss, and increasingly more stringent data protection regulations require new, advanced technologies that enable audience addressability while respecting people’s privacy preferences. ID5 has risen to this challenge and developed solutions that support publishers’ and marketers’ need for better addressability. Its laser focus on Identity sets it apart from competitive solutions and enables the company to offer the most advanced and sophisticated identity services to over 100,000 media properties, and hundreds of technology platforms and advertisers, making it the most adopted identity solution in the market. The Opportunity Identity is the biggest unsolved problem on the open web, and ID5 is building the infrastructure to fix it. The ID5 ID is already trusted by thousands of partners across ad tech. Our recent acquisition of TrueData expanded us into the US, audience data, and onboarding, and we're now doubling down on the next frontiers: Measurement and Onboarding. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own a critical area of our roadmap end-to-end. You'll help define the problems worth solving, ship the features that solve them, and partner closely with engineering, marketing, sales, and partnerships to bring them to market. Every feature you ship has a measurable impact on how publishers monetise, how advertisers reach audiences, and how the open web competes with the walled gardens. What You'll Do Working closely with our Director of Product you will support a critical area of the ID5 product end-to-end, across the different ID products. Run a clearly scoped, prioritised backlog of epics and features that engineering can execute on without ambiguity. Define the "what" and "why" behind every release, partnering with Product Marketing to turn technical capability into value propositions that resonate with publishers, SSPs, DSPs, agencies, and advertisers. Arm Sales and Client Growth with the proof points they need to win complex deals against sophisticated buyers and competing identity solutions. Drive outcomes end-to-end by making decisions, removing ambiguity, and bringing engineering, marketing, and partnerships with you. What We're Looking For Demonstrable product management experience in ad tech, ideally with hands-on exposure to programmatic, Connected TV, identity, attribution, or measurement. Strong problem and solution definition. You frame the right problem before solving it, even under genuine ambiguity. Confident prioritisation when not everything can be first, and a rationale you can defend. Stakeholder influence at peer and senior levels across product, engineering, marketing, sales, and partnerships. Deep curiosity, an ownership mindset, and comfort working ahead of the data. Nice To Have Hands-on technical fluency that lets you make architectural trade-offs with engineering rather than around them. Experience with measurement, attribution, audience onboarding, or identity at a DSP, SSP, DMP, CDP, or measurement provider. Why You'll Love Working Here Build at the heart of how the open web reaches and measures audiences. The infrastructure for the next decade is being designed right now, and your work will help shape it. Own product areas with genuine end-to-end autonomy, working alongside a senior, opinionated team that gives clear feedback and enjoys the craft. Be stretched continuously across technical, analytical, and commercial problems that genuinely matter for the open web. Operate fully remote, with the access to leadership and the autonomy to leave a visible mark. What we offer to our talent Remote-first working policy A competitive compensation package, including stock options in ID5 WeWork membership and option to work from different WeWork locations Regular offsites to enjoy face-to-face time and to bond further with you

alphapartners-coupang:greenhouse:7936613.description: 회사 소개 쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다. 쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요. 조직 소개 Coupang Ads는 세계 최고 수준의 광고 솔루션을 제공하는 조직을 지향합니다. Coupang Ads는 광고주가 매출 증대, 시장 점유율 증가, 신규 고객 확보 및 브랜드 자산 구축과 같은 마케팅 목표를 달성할 수 있도록 돕습니다. 우리의 솔루션은 광고주의 니즈를 반영하며, 광고주의 규모와는 상관없이 그들의 비즈니스 성장을 돕기 위해 기획합니다. Coupang Ads는 Sales, Marketing, Video Product, Operations, Product, Engineering 팀과 같은 다기능적이고 협업적인 팀들로 구성되어 있습니다. 우리는 각자의 분야에서 전문가이며 항상 광고주를 우리가 하는 모든 일의 중심에 둡니다. 우리는 제품과 서비스에 열정을 가지고 있으며 이는 우리가 하는 일의 가치를 높여 줍니다. Coupang Ads 구성원들은 Coupang Ads를 일하기 좋은 곳으로 만드는데 큰 역할을 하며, 우리는 빠르게 변화하는 역동적인 환경에서 일하고 싶어하는 다양한 배경을 가진 사람들을 고용하고 개발하며, 각 직원이 존중과 권한을 부여 받고 지원받는다고 느낄 수 있는 환경을 만들어갑니다. 이런 환경과 사람들은 광고주를 대신하여 혁신적인 관점을 제공할 수 있습니다. 우리는 고객중심의 생각, 끈기, 사려 깊음, 그리고 신속한 행동을 직접 보여줄 수 있는 자질을 중요하게 생각합니다. 우리의 목표는 세계 최고의 광고 팀에서 일하기에 가장 좋은 장소를 만드는 것입니다. 혁신적이고 역동적인 환경에서 업계를 선도하고, 팀과 함께 성장을 달성하고자 하는 열정적인 분이라면 Coupang Ads와 함께하세요. Coupang Ads에서 여러분은 세계에서 가장 가치 있고 가장 빠르게 성장하는 광고 솔루션 중 하나를 제공하게 될 것입니다. 팀 소개 Coupang Ads 내 Acquisition Sales 조직의 HVA LT Sales팀은 아직 쿠팡 광고를 경험해 보지 못한 쿠팡 셀러들의 광고 영입을 목적으로 적절한 광고 솔루션을 제안하여 경쟁자들 사이에서 입지를 더 단단히 하고, 비즈니스를 지속적으로 성장시킬 수 있도록 전문적인 지식 바탕의 컨설팅 제공을 통해 고객사가 목표하는 바를 구현하여 Long-term relationship building 의 발판을 마련합니다. 업무 내용 Long tail 레벨의 매출을 가진 셀러들의 첫 광고 Sales를 진행하는 팀의 AE 가이드 및 관리 팀의 우선 순위를 정확히 인지하고, 문제 발생 시 정확한 문제 원인을 확인하고, 그에 맞는 액션플랜을 만들어 실행 실시간으로 AE들의 액티비티와 성과를 트랙킹 등의 세세한 관리를 바탕으로 밀착 코칭을 통해 높은 퍼포먼스 세일즈 인력 양성 세일즈 콜 모니터링, 다양한 카테고리의 잠재고객 공략을 위해 카테고리 상품, 매출 트렌드, 경쟁사 현황, 소비자 데이터 등의 다양한 마켓 데이터내 인사이트를 활용하여 합리적인 Objection handling 방안을 제시하고 이를 바탕으로 지속적인 세일즈 스크립트를 관리/개선 Ad-hoc으로 진행되는 신규 Task를 신속하고 유연하게 실행하고 이에 따른 결과를 트랙킹하며 리포트 자격 요건 세일즈 팀의 People manager 경험 최소 3년 이상 있으신 분 디지털 광고 또는 이커머스 등 유관 업계 경력 최소 10년 이상 보유하신 분 월간 또는 분기 단위로 세일즈 목표를 받아 성과 관리를 해오신 분 스스로 높은 목표치 세우고 이를 달성하기 위해 적극적으로 액션 하시는 분 광고 데이터 및 매출 데이터를 비롯해 다양한 마켓 데이터 활용에 경험이 많고 인사이트 도출을 자주 해본 분 빠른 변화와 새로운 환경에 빠르게 적응하는 분 우대 사항 7명 이상의 규모의 큰 팀을 리드해본 경험이 있으신 분 디지털 광고 또는 이커머스 관리 및 파트너 매니지먼트 경력이 있으신 분 퍼포먼스 마케팅 관련 업무 경력이 있으신 분 비즈니스 영어가 가능하신 분 전형 절차 및 안내 사항 전형 절차 서류전형 - Our Studio AI suite offers more than 26 specialized AI tools that automate technical work: generate custom images, remove backgrounds, create fonts, and produce publication-ready designs in minutes instead of hours. Our content library contains 15+ million commercially-licensed fonts, graphics, SVGs, and templates, giving you professional-quality building blocks without the expense or time of creating assets from scratch. About the role: Creative Fabrica Studio AI is an AI platform for generating images, videos, music, speech, sound effects, and more. 30+ tools. All the creative firepower you'd normally need five different subscriptions for, in one place. We're already adding hundreds of thousands of new users every month. You'll create the accounts, figure out what content hits, post at high volume, and scale distribution through a network of reposters and remixers. You own the whole thing. What you post, how often, which formats, which platforms, how you grow it. The only metric that matters is that millions of people discover Studio AI through your content. This role is for someone who's already done this. You've built faceless pages, you know what makes content spread, and you want to do it backed by a platform with real tools and real scale behind it. What you will do: Get millions of people to discover Studio AI. You do this by creating faceless short-form content on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts that generates massive reach. You're posting multiple times a day across every account you manage. The formats, the hooks, the angles: that's all you. The only thing that matters is that it gets views and people end up at Studio AI. You know what drives massive reach on these platforms. Rage bait, controversy, provocative hooks, memes, engagement bait, trending audio, story-driven shorts. Content that makes people react, share, argue, tag someone, and save it. Not content people passively scroll past. Run multiple faceless accounts, each with its own niche and audience. Manage the posting rhythm, visual identity, and growth of each one. Test constantly. Kill what doesn’t perform. Double down on what does. Build a library of proven formats and a playbook that compounds over time. Build a network of reposters/remixers who take your proven content and spread it, either by reposting directly or by producing their own variations of the same concept. Scale distribution from your own accounts to hundreds. What you will need: You've built faceless accounts from zero to 50K+ followers on TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube. You can show the accounts, the content, and the growth. You think in hooks. You know the difference between content people watch and content people share. You understand outrage, curiosity, tribal identity, humor, and you know which lever to pull for which platform. You produce fast. Idea to live post in under 20 minutes. CapCut or equivalent, text overlays, trending audio, transitions, platform-native formats. Speed is the job. You know how to scale a winner. Break down why it hit, turn it into a repeatable format, produce scalable variations, build the playbook. You track what matters. Platform analytics, UTMs, attribution. You know which content is actually driving people to Studio AI, not just which one got views. alven-neural-concept:ashbyhq:333c5357-82.description: About the Role The mission of Neural Concept’s ML Application Engineering team is to help our customers in Korea and solve their most complex engineering challenges. We collaborate closely with engineering and design teams within the automotive, aerospace and energy industries, understand their challenges and pains, and help them identify solutions to accelerate their conception processes. We leverage our platform to unlock the value of the most complex computer-aided engineering datasets and to create a direct impact on product design processes. Using 3D deep learning and engineering intelligence, we empower our customers to develop better products faster. As a key player in the Application Engineering Team, your mission will be to help industry leaders to redefine their product design workflow with cutting-edge technologies. Your expertise should establish trust and admiration from our customers by delivering high-quality technical work. This is a chance to be at the intersection of engineering and AI, working with top-tier customers worldwide while shaping how the industry evolves. If you are interested in feeling firsthand the fast progress of engineering, this is the team for you. What you will do - You will run projects together with our customer’s engineering teams, analyze and process engineering data using our platform and python libraries, and develop tailored solutions and workflows - You will apply our machine- and deep-learning workflows to different engineering/physics problems, as well as deliver proofs-of-concept demonstrating how our technology creates value in CAD, CAE, and manufacturing. - You will train customer teams to effectively use our methods and platform, ensuring smooth AI adoption into their workflows. - You will work closely with our developers to translate customer needs and feedback into product improvements. Who you are - You are eager to tackle real-world challenges through machine learning and automation, with a passion for reshaping how engineering is practiced by industry leaders - You hold a Master’s or PhD degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or Physics - You have an excellent understanding of both Engineering and Machine Learning (strict requirement) - You have strong experience with Python programming, and experience with machine learning and deep learning frameworks and libraries (strict requirement) - You have experience with simulation. Industry experience in CAD / CAE (CFD, FEM, etc) modelling is a plus - You can convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and compelling way - You have excellent communication skills, enjoy working with people, and feel comfortable in the customer-facing role - You are fluent in English and Korean or Japanese (preferably native)- mandatory requirement. What You Get - Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence. - Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale. - Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized. - Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another. - Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable. - Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules. What You Will Be Location : Lausanne (Switzerland), UK, India, USA Eligibility: we do provide Swiss visa sponsorship for a successful candidate Travelling: Regular travels to South Korea and/ or Japan WE'RE PROUD TO BE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER, AND WE'RE COMMITTED TO BUILDING A DIVERSE AND INCLUSIVE ENVIRONMENT WHERE YOU CAN THRIVE.

baincapital-crusoe:ashbyhq:2434efc4-dfa9.title: Staff Software Engineer, Networking
baincapital-crusoe:ashbyhq:2434efc4-dfa9.description: Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. About the Role: Crusoe Cloud seeks a highly skilled and experienced Staff Software Engineer to lead the development and execution of our cutting-edge Software Defined Networking strategy. nea-cloudflare:greenhouse:7462801.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Data Retrieval: Be responsible for building the customer-facing products that make data accessible and actionable. This includes developing our public GraphQL API, building robust log delivery solutions and integrations with customer destinations, and contributing to our alerting products, which empower users to configure and receive near real-time alerts based on the logs and metrics observed by our data platform. Build and optimise key components of our high-throughput data delivery platform to ensure data integrity and low-latency delivery. Develop new and improve existing components for the Cloudflare Analytical Platform to extend functionality and performance.
